summary: Completed testing of AGRICAM IA payment flow bug fix (JWT secret mismatch). All 8 backend API tests passed (100%). Full payment flow verified working: Login → /paiements page loads (no 401 redirect) → Select package → Fill phone → Click Pay → Processing → Success page redirect. Success and Failure pages display correctly.
